description: Reads one top-four tournament placing from list_winning_lists as it imports under today's army data: its placing, whether it is legal today, record and event, the army text the player submitted, draft (the list in the shape check_roster, grade_roster, compare_rosters and save_roster take) and summary, which names each unit with its points, models, wargear, enhancements, Warlord and attachments. Grade the draft with grade_roster or set it against another list with compare_rosters rather than judging it yourself.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: get_winning_list
title: Read a tournament-winning list
